content.value: The inventory panel lists material-based recipes that fit the vanilla 2 x 2 crafting grid. No arrangement of materials in a grid is required.
Materials can come from your hotbar, regular inventory and unlocked bag storage. The [[article/crafting_table|Crafting Table]] also includes these hand-crafting recipes.
A recipe becomes visible after you have obtained at least one valid alternative for every required ingredient. Discovery belongs to each player, not the party or the whole server.
Search by the output name, use the material-search mode to find uses for an ingredient, or enable Craftable to see recipes you currently have materials for. Category tabs narrow the list.

Type the number of recipe operations in the quantity field or use its buttons. Check the total output beside the quantity: one operation can produce several items. Batches can exceed one stack when materials and storage allow.

Crafted output merges with matching unfinished stacks first. New stacks use hotbar, regular inventory, then unlocked bag storage. The station validates materials and output capacity before completing a craft.
